objective: Build a deterministic fit-only raw-image node-proposal universe, then compile a bounded node-restoration-only action population through frozen N1. No graph score is run.

raw_generator_contract.name: BLOCKPEAK-RESTORE-V1
raw_generator_contract.input: every raw frame in the exact 36 fit105 44b6 Zarr arrays
raw_generator_contract.threshold: dataset Zarr attribute image_statistics.quantiles['0.999']; frozen metadata, never fit labels
raw_generator_contract.peak: one C-order argmax per complete nonoverlapping block
raw_generator_contract.streaming: one frame and one video at a time; raw banks are frozen before the fit-GT audit pass

coverage_identity_gate.required_frames: all raw array frames for every identity
coverage_identity_gate.required_replay: byte-identical regeneration of first and last frame per video

fit_only_identity_audit.positive_definition: one-to-one minimum-distance same-time fit-GT assignment within 7 um
fit_only_identity_audit.false_definition: raw proposal not selected by that assignment
fit_only_identity_audit.hard_false_definition: false proposal with nearest same-time fit GT strictly greater than 14 um, or a frame without fit GT
fit_only_identity_audit.leakage_rule: fit GT may annotate and choose false stress actions only after raw generation; it never changes raw coordinates, inclusion, order, or identity

node_restoration_contract.topology_join: nearest baseline node at t-1 and t+1, each within 16 um
node_restoration_contract.conflict_proof: declare every baseline edge outgoing from the predecessor or incoming to the successor as expected_conflict_edges
node_restoration_contract.compatibility: greedy exact ownership of added node/edges, replaced source/target, and removed edges
node_restoration_contract.n1_validation: compile every retained action singly and compile every per-video budget batch through interface 2a72950c...f865

false_node_budget_stress.construction: first k globally ordered mutually compatible false-proposal restoration actions

decision_lines.generator_go: 36/36 identities and all frames covered; exact raw-bank schema; all deterministic replays equal
decision_lines.generator_park: any coverage, identity, input, or determinism failure
decision_lines.population_go: 50 mutually compatible false-node restoration actions and 50/50 frozen-N1 single-action validity plus all budget batches valid
decision_lines.population_park: fewer than 50 actions or any frozen-N1 rejection
decision_lines.tier_move: none; this prerequisite can only unblock NODETOPO-O0 for a later human-reviewed graph gate
